title: EM Weekly - October 26, 2026
overview: Sample weekly digest containing all three historical articles added to EM Weekly this week. These studies are from 2023–2024; this is a format preview, not a current literature review.
clinicalTakeaways: PREOXI: NIV preoxygenation reduced peri-intubation hypoxemia compared with an oxygen mask in selected critically ill adults.
DEVICE: Video laryngoscopy increased first-attempt success in critically ill adults; operator experience and setting affect applicability.
CLOVERS: A restrictive fluid strategy with earlier vasopressors did not significantly reduce mortality compared with liberal fluids in sepsis-induced hypotension.
